claim_boundary: No emitted codec or achieved finite MSE is claimed. Exact source-specific coefficient values are granted at nominal one-bit/FP16 storage with zero quantisation loss, so a failure is an early-kill for these families; a pass would require finite integration.

matched_gaussian_adaptive_union.claim_boundary: Source-aware per-matrix family selection and free mode labels; this is an upper bound, not an operational format.

decision.rule: Early-kill unless a held-out/free predictor preserves F<=0.8 and its exact private field fits the strict 0.117869-bpw gate.

source_adaptive_union.claim_boundary: Source-aware per-matrix family selection and free mode labels; this is an upper bound, not an operational format.

protocol.heldout_unit: one complete expert triplet; no target Gate/Up/Down normal enters shared fits
protocol.matched_gaussian: independent deterministic controls match every target matrix's exact mean and centered energy, reuse its selected polar rank, and reselect the best window
optimism: source-specific coefficients are exact despite one-bit/FP16 ledgers
coefficient subspace DOF is removed from the coded normal dimension
ideal asymptotic Gaussian coding for remaining manifold/normal components
shared tables use full-model amortized rate
source-adaptive family union gets free mode labels
predictor_families: identity/DCT diagonal and banded normal matrices
decoder-visible same-layer router PCA and routed-expert row bases
